posts.author: Pandai
posts.title: Busted by cops.
posts.html:
Ok, so can anyone tell me if this is a bullshit reason to be threatened for jail?
 
   So I was walking with a friend to my girlfriends party, then I see a white car behind me and I am thinking shit... It was a cop. He stops us so I say "Whatsup sir?" He does the regular rundown of questions like name, ssn, birthdate, and where do I live. I answered all of them. He asks what i was out for so I just said going back to my house. He says ok then, want a ride? So of course I said no and then he said it was not a question. I got in the cop car and was being kind of a dick to him because I was a little high at the time asking him if he has every done frontflips through a 711 to stop a robbery, he did not laugh at all, he just told me to shut up. I went home which was about a 4 minute drive because he decided to blow off every stop sign on the way their in the suburbs where I live. Once home I had to wake my dad up so the cop could sign some shit. Now I am grounded at home for being out after curfew at the age of 17. Would be cool if I was 12, but this is just gay. I was 4 days away from my birthday at the time. He decided to give me a 70$ fine and put it on my record because I already had a record. He judged my past and instead of giving a warning he gave me another mark on my record.

 Anyone else thinks this is a bullshit reason, or are the cops just too damn uptight?
